descriptions.zh:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§!辨认出了在§Y[from.GetName]§!的神秘飞行物是一颗古老的气象气球。这颗行星上极端的大气条件已经将其上任何可能用来辨识其起源的信息都抹除殆尽了。

放射性定年表明它已经在[from.GetName]的大气层中至少飘了一个世纪，它在行星特有的压力变化中随波逐流，大小也随之涨缩。

不可思议的是，它的太阳能电池板仍然在运行，上面的传感器阵列现在携带着一个世纪的宝贵大气数据。这激起了我们[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]的极大兴趣。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§! has identified the mysterious airborne object on §Y[from.GetName]§! as an archaic weather balloon. Any markings that could have identified its origin have long since been stripped away by the planet's extreme atmospheric conditions.

Radiometric dating suggests it has been present in [from.GetName]'s atmosphere for over a century, fluctuating in size as it travels listlessly through the planet's idiosyncratic pressure variations.

Miraculously, the solar energy panels are still functioning and its sensor array now carries a century's worth of valuable atmospheric data. It will be of great interest to our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers].

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§!确认§Y[from.GetName]§!上的熔岩海洋含有元素周期表中几乎所有已知稀有金属的极纯形式。

这种高浓度的液态金属汇聚产生狂暴的电磁场，导致熔融金属海啸的频发。

我们利用预测模型确定了海啸之间存在的短暂但有规律的间歇，可以利用来收获这些独特的丰富矿藏。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§! has confirmed that the lava oceans on §Y[from.GetName]§! contain exceptionally pure forms of almost every known rare metalloid in our elemental catalog.

This concentrated collection of liquid metals gives rise to highly volatile electromagnetic fields, causing the frequent formation of molten metal tsunamis.

Using predictive modeling, we have identified brief but regular lulls in wave intensity which can be used to harvest these uniquely rich deposits.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!上的大蓝点其实是一对双生超级风暴；一个气旋和一个反气旋互相支持形成了一种完美的平衡。

这对风暴规模巨大，风速通常都突破音障，持续发出强烈音爆。风暴中含有大量的钴金属尘，使其显出了独特的蓝色。

§Y[Leader.GetName]§!估计这对风暴已经在这呼啸了超过一个世纪，其在上层大气所积累的矿物应该用开采站就很容易采集起来了。
descriptions.en:
The large blue spots on §Y[from.GetName]§! are a pair of symbiotic super storms; a cyclone and anticyclone that sustain each other in a state of perfect equilibrium.

The storms are massive in scale with wind speeds regularly breaking the sound barrier, creating powerful sonic booms. Vast volumes of cobalt dust are present within, giving the spots their distinctive color.

§Y[Leader.GetName]§! estimates they have been raging continuously here for over a century. The minerals they have accumulated in the upper atmosphere should be easily recoverable with a mining station.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§!完成了对§Y[from.GetName]§!这颗冰封星球上异常热点的调查。

在星球表面无尽的冻土带下埋藏着高度活泼的火山沉积物。这些物质起初处于惰性状态深埋冰下，但随着大陆冰盖的漂移和破裂被周期性地向上输送。

这些超易燃气体在上升到地表时很容易在[from.GetName]的富氧大气中猝燃，频繁地在行星表面发生闪爆。

这些独特的易燃物质可以使用特殊设备加以提取并在别处排上用场。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§! concluded their investigation of the erratic heat spikes on the frozen world of §Y[from.GetName]§!.

Buried beneath the unending tundra of the planet's surface are highly reactive pyrophoric deposits. Initially kept inert deep beneath the ice, these substances are periodically sifted upwards as the continental ice sheets drift and break apart.

Thawing as they rise to the surface, these ultra-flammable gasses are prone to sudden ignition in [from.GetName]'s oxygen-rich atmosphere, causing frequent flash fires across the surface of the planet.

With specialized equipment, these uniquely combustible substances can be extracted and put to use elsewhere.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!是一种非凡的地衣物种的家园，它们将剧毒分子排入大气中，以保护自己免受捕食者的侵害。

化石记录的研究得知[from.GetName]曾经有丰富多样的物种，但这种地衣以超出生物所能适应的速度梯度提高了大气中的砷和铊浓度，这些物种都被被逐一灭绝了。

§Y[Leader.GetName]§!只发现了另一种存活的有机体，是一种大型类爬行动物，它们要靠特别高效的解毒腺体在这种环境中存活下来。

对这种非凡器官的进一步研究可能会对大气解毒产生洞见。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.GetName]§! is home to a remarkable species of lichen which expels ultra-toxic molecules into the atmosphere as a method to secure itself against predation.

Studies of the fossil record suggest [from.GetName] once had a diverse range of fauna which the lichen has killed off over time by gradually raising levels of arsenic and thallium in the atmosphere faster than most could adapt.

§Y[Leader.GetName]§! discovered only one other living organism, a species of large reptiloids, has been able to survive to such conditions thanks to a uniquely efficient detoxification gland.

Further study of this remarkable organ could yield insights into atmospheric detoxification.

descriptions.en:
§Y[from.GetName]§! is home to a remarkable species of lichen which expels ultra-toxic molecules into the atmosphere as a method to secure itself against predation.

Studies of the fossil record suggest [from.GetName] once had a diverse range of fauna which the lichen has killed off over time by gradually raising levels of arsenic and thallium in the atmosphere faster than most could adapt.

§Y[Leader.GetName]§! discovered only one other living organism, a species of large reptiloids, has been able to survive to such conditions thanks to a uniquely efficient detoxification gland.

Further study of this remarkable organ could yield insights into atmospheric detoxification. Initial experiments also indicate that the unique compounds inside the poisons could be repurposed for use in the cosmetic industry.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!上发现的类爬行类腺体进行了深入研究之后，§Y[Leader.GetName]§!发现它们对行星毒性独特抵抗力背后的生物学秘密。

这种复杂的器官会分泌一种可以对毒性大气起到中和作用的化合物，避免这种类爬行动物的循环系统吸收毒素。这种极具适应力的腺体甚至可以中和掉我们实验室制造的最致命的毒素。

这些非凡的发现将彻底改变我们大气排毒的方式。
descriptions.en:
Through intensive study of the reptiloid glands on §Y[from.GetName]§!, §Y[Leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the biological secrets of their remarkable resistance to the planet's toxicity.

This complex organ produces compounds which act as neutralizing agents to the poisonous atmosphere, preventing toxins from being absorbed by the reptile's circulatory system. This highly adaptive gland is even able to nullify our most lethal lab-generated poisons.

These extraordinary findings will transform our approaches to atmospheric detoxification.

descriptions.zh:
通过§Y[from.GetName]§!上的暂时开口送入探测器，§Y[Leader.GetName]§!发现行星的内核是一种单细胞有机物种的家园，它们与此前见过的一切生物都不相似。

这些强韧的细胞似乎完美地适应了在极端压力下的生活，它们季节性的繁殖活动会排出体积可观的氢气。[Leader.GetName]认为这就是行星之所以能维持氢气层的原因。

消灭这些生物能使外层的消散，获得一颗可殖民的石质行星。
descriptions.en:
By sending a probe deep into one of the temporary vents on §Y[from.GetName]§!, §Y[Leader.GetName]§! discovered that the planet's core is home to a species of unicellular organisms unlike anything we have seen before.

These robust cells seem perfectly adapted for survival under extreme pressures, with their seasonal reproduction releasing sizable quantities of hydrogen. [Leader.GetName] has concluded that this is how the planet's gassy hydrogen layers are being maintained.

Exterminating these organisms would cause the dissipation of these outer layers, leaving behind a colonizable rocky planet.

label.zh: 这是个独特的观测机会。

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§!通过§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上的一个开口送入了一台武器化的探测器。一抵达核心，其上的有毒载荷就会释放，侵染并灭绝当地的单细胞生物。

我们发现[from.From.GetName]的气态外层逐渐消散在虚空中，余下的是一颗小巧的岩质行星。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§! sent a weaponized probe into one of the openings on §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! surface. Once at the core, a toxic payload was released, infecting and exterminating its native single-celled organisms.

We observed as [from.From.GetName]'s gassy outer layers gradually dissipated into the void, leaving behind a small and rocky planet.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!地表的进一步调查发现了我们在轨调查时遇到的这些光学现象的成因。

大气条件将星球的大部分永久冻土打磨出透明的光泽，揭示了隐藏其下的生长着多色晶体的深层网络。从远处观察，这些自然现象产生了如万花筒般的效果。

虽然它具有传统的美学价值，但这里丰富的矿藏才是我们关注的真正目标。
descriptions.en:
Closer inspection of §Y[from.GetName]§!'s surface discovered the cause of the optical phenomena encountered during our orbital surveys.

Atmospheric conditions have polished large sections of the planet's permafrost to a transparent sheen, revealing deep networks of multi-colored crystal growths lurking beneath. These naturally occurring phenomena give rise to a kaleidoscopic effect when observed from afar.

While conventionally aesthetically pleasing, the rich mineral deposits that lie within are the real target of our attention.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§!发现了§Y[from.GetName]§!上的这些超热等离子喷流的源头。

这颗行星的独特磁场促进了地幔深处电离物质之间的反应，形成了高压等离子体的熔岩室。

行星上不稳定的构造板块坍塌时，这些等离子体就像致命的炮弹一样向上射出，与大气中的气体一起点燃，产生二次爆炸。我们的武器专家热衷于将这些原理应用于自己的等离子武器。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the cause of the superheated plasma eruptions on §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The unique magnetic field of the planet facilitates a reaction between ionized materials deep within the planetary mantle, creating volcanic chambers of highly pressurized plasma.

When the unstable tectonic plates of the planet give way, this plasma is explosively propelled upward as a deadly projectile, igniting with gasses in the atmosphere to create secondary explosions. Our weapons specialists are keen to apply these principles to our own plasma-based armaments.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是，这项高度危险的研究给[Leader.GetName]留下了严重的精神创伤。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [Leader.GetName] with severe traumatization.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是，这项高度危险的研究给[Leader.GetName]留下了严重的物理损伤。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [Leader.GetName] with severe physical injuries.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!异常的黑云事实上是某种大型食肉昆虫的密集虫群。

这些长着翅膀的掠食者在岩石裂缝中筑巢，每天定时从中倾巢而出，吞吃星球表面所剩无几的有机物。

得益于强大的新陈代谢可以在在进食时逆转细胞衰变，使得这些节肢动物只要定期消耗营养就能无限期地延长寿命。
descriptions.en:
The unusual black clouds on §Y[from.GetName]§! are actually dense swarms of large carnivorous insects.

These winged predators nest in rock fissures and emerge once daily to devour any scant organic matter available on the planet's surface.

Thanks to a potent metabolism which reverses cell decay upon feeding, these arthropods can prolong their lifespan indefinitely, as long as nutrients are consumed regularly.

descriptions.zh: 在田野调查分析的过程中，[Leader.GetName]的[Leader.Species.GetHandName]被其中的一个标本咬伤，下a额触发了一种显著的代谢响应。这种独特的物种身上还有很多关于有机细胞再生能力的知识可以学习。
descriptions.en: During fieldwork analysis, [Leader.GetName]'s [Leader.Species.GetHandName] was bitten by one of the specimens, triggering a remarkable metabolic response. This unique species has much to teach us about the regenerative capacities of organic cells.

label.zh: 把它们全部挖出来用掉。

descriptions.zh:
深海回声定位和地震遥感相结合定位出了§Y[from.GetName]§!深层振动的源头。其液态氮构成的冰下海洋是一大群巨型鳍脚类动物的家园，它们已经适应了如此严苛的生存环境。

这种引人注目的生物无论是尺寸还是重量都与一艘小型运输舰相当。他们发出强力的低频嗡嗡声来进行交流，这种声音甚至可以在整个行星范围内回荡。一种独特的富含胶原蛋白的鲸脂保护着它们免受低温烧伤和霜冻，同时还能在海洋中放大它们的叫声。

这些巨型动物在这个孤立的生态系统中没有任何天敌，它们非常温顺，通过重复它们独特的声音很容易就能吸引到洋面上。
descriptions.en:
A combination of deep sea echolocation and seismic telemetry has located the source of the deep vibrations on §Y[from.GetName]§!. Its subglacial liquid nitrogen ocean is home to vast herds of gigantic pinnipeds who have adapted to life in this harsh environment.

The remarkable creatures have the size and mass of a small transport craft. To communicate, they emit a powerful low-frequency drone that can reverberate on a planetwide scale. A uniquely collagen-rich blubber protects them from cryogenic burns and frostbite, while at the same time amplifying their calls across the sea.

Lacking any natural predators in this isolated ecosystem, these large animals are curious, highly docile, and can be easily drawn to the surface by replicating their idiosyncratic vocalizations.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Leader.GetName]§!找到了§Y[from.GetName]§!上深层海洋电流的来源。

这片海底是一种具有发电能力的复杂冷水珊瑚物种的家园。该物种使用独特的细胞器产生电流来吸引微生物，亦作为一种捕食和交流的手段。

我们的探测器对珊瑚有刺激作用，只要我们改变传输频率，珊瑚就会做出反应，提高电流输出。

仔细调节与这种深水物种的互动，我们就可以在不破坏脆弱生态系统的前提下增加星球的能源输出。
descriptions.en:
The source of the deep sea electrical currents on §Y[from.GetName]§! has been identified by §Y[Leader.GetName]§!.

The ocean floor is home to a complex species of cold-water coral with electrogenetic capabilities. This species uses specialized organelles to generate current to lure microorganisms as both a means of sustenance and communication.

Our survey probes are acting as a stimulant for the coral, which reacts by increasing its electrical output whenever we change a transmission frequency.

By carefully modulating our interactions with this deep water species, we can increase the planet's energy output without disrupting the delicate ecosystem.

descriptions.zh:
基于对§Y[from.GetName]§!沉积物的研究，我们发现这颗星球曾经遍布火山，却遭到了骤冷事件，其表面的熔岩变成了成片成片的火山玻璃。

行星表面无数的撞击坑表明该事件可能是由于外源天体，例如彗星风暴的撞击导致的。在这些黑曜石结构的内部是巨大的空洞和因骤冷事件被从火山口捕获其中的含硫气体。

通过精准的提取我们就能收获这些资源为自己所用。
descriptions.en:
Based on sedimentary analysis of §Y[from.GetName]§!, we have discovered that this once volcanic world experienced a sudden flash freezing event, turning its surface lava into a sheen of volcanic glass.

The many impact craters on the planet's surface suggest this was most likely caused by an external celestial impact, such as a meteor storm. Contained within these obsidian formations are large bubbles of trapped sulfuric gasses from the volcanic vents now sealed by the flash freeze.

With precise extraction, we will be able to harvest these resources for our own needs.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经找到了§Y[from.GetName]§!上探测器失踪的原因。

构成这颗行星大气的各气体层之间表现出巨大的温差。气体层剧烈摩擦时，这种剧变就产生了强烈的逆流。

这一点，再加上每种气体密度的差异，形成了灾难性的剪切力，让任何穿过大气圈层的物体都被无情撕碎。

既然我们了解了这种现象，就可以改造设备使其能承受这种极端条件，从而利用这种自然现象的动能。
descriptions.en:
We have identified the cause of our probes' disappearance on §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The various gaseous strata that make up the planet's atmosphere exhibit dramatic temperature differentials. These drastic variations create a sharp countercurrent as layers of gas move violently in opposing directions.

This, combined with the contrasting densities of each gas, fosters cataclysmic shearing forces that tear apart anything transitioning between the atmospheric layers.

Now that we know what to expect, our own equipment can be modified to endure these extreme conditions, letting us harness the kinetic force of this natural phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的地理进行进一步探测发现其硅酸盐地幔中存在一个巨大的地下网络。

探测器显示，这些洞穴居住着一种生活在硅酸盐岩石内的深地幔环节动物。大量的这种生物从内部吞噬着星球，然后将消化的废物喷射到行星轨道上，被宇宙风剥离。

消灭这些环节动物可以让我们的[controller.GetMinerPlural_lower]获得大量高品易得的硅酸盐矿石。
descriptions.en:
Closer inspection of §Y[from.GetName]'s§! geology found that its silicate mantle features a sprawling network of large subterranean burrows.

Exploratory probes revealed that these hollows are home to a thriving species of deep mantle annelid which subsists on silicate rock. Vast colonies of these creatures are devouring the planet from within, then ejecting the digested waste into planetary orbit where it is stripped away by cosmic winds.

Exterminating the annelids would grant our [controller.GetMinerPlural_lower] access to extensive quantities of easily accessible silicate ore.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的地理进行进一步探测发现其硅酸盐地幔中存在一个巨大的地下网络。

探测器显示，这些洞穴居住着一种生活在硅酸盐岩石内的深地幔环节动物。大量的这种生物从内部吞噬着星球，然后将消化的废物喷射到行星轨道上，被宇宙风剥离。

消灭这些环节动物可以让我们的[controller.GetMinerPlural_lower]获得大量高品易得的硅酸盐矿石。它们的饮食非常引人注目，与我们相差无几。
descriptions.en:
Closer inspection of §Y[from.GetName]'s§! geology found that its silicate mantle features a sprawling network of large subterranean burrows.

Exploratory probes revealed that these hollows are home to a thriving species of deep mantle annelid which subsists on silicate rock. Vast colonies of these creatures are devouring the planet from within, then ejecting the digested waste into planetary orbit where it is stripped away by cosmic winds.

Exterminating the annelids would grant our [controller.GetMinerPlural_lower] access to extensive quantities of easily accessible silicate ore. Their appetite is impressive, and not so different from ours.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的永夜半球形成了一种独特的演化环境，让少数有机体能够生存在这颗严酷的行星上。

得益于独特的遗传特性，这里的生物群全都是半透明的，它们没有任何视觉，赖以非常复杂的回声定位生存。这种独特的适应性让我们的[controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower]们颇感兴趣。
descriptions.en:
The permanently dark side of §Y[from.GetName]§! has fostered a unique evolutionary environment for the few organisms able to survive this harsh world.

Thanks to a unique chromosomal variation, the fauna here are entirely translucent, possess no vision, and deploy sophisticated forms of echolocation to survive. These remarkable adaptations are of great interest to our [controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower].

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的永夜半球形成了一种独特的演化环境，让少数有机体能够生存在这颗严酷的行星上。

得益于独特的遗传特性，这里的生物群全都是半透明的，它们没有任何视觉，赖以非常复杂的回声定位生存。
descriptions.en:
The permanently dark side of §Y[from.GetName]§! has fostered a unique evolutionary environment for the few organisms able to survive this harsh world.

Thanks to a unique chromosomal variation, the fauna here are entirely translucent, possess no vision, and deploy sophisticated forms of echolocation to survive.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { controller = { is_homicidal = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!上荧光河流的分析发现其中居住着某种独特的微生物。

这些生物利用化学合成作用来代谢有害物质，并产生高度反应性的副产物。这些副产物改变河流的化学构成，造就了这种强烈的变色效果。

它们发出的充满活力的霓虹灯色调同时也是一种交流手段，用以表明它们的生育状况，在穿越星球上有毒溪流的同时吸引配偶。

继续研究这些生物及其生命周期可以为我们的[controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower]们带来不俗的研究机会。
descriptions.en:
Analysis of the fluorescent rivers on §Y[from.GetName]§! has revealed they are home to a unique species of microbial life.

Using chemosynthesis to metabolize harmful compounds, these creatures generate highly reactive byproducts that alter the river's chemical composition, causing dramatic color shifts.

Doubling as a means of communication, the vibrant neon hues they create are used to signal fertility status, attracting mates as they travel through the planet's toxic streams.

Continued study of these creatures and their lifecycle will provide a fascinating research opportunity for our [controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower].

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]的§!异常大气捕获了大量的恒星辐射，导致行星暖化的连锁效应，甚至连金属都转化为高度活泼的气态形式存在。

这些化合物会与我们投放的所有调查设备瞬间发生反应，在表面附上一层结实的合金薄膜。而这一过程竟然不具有破坏性。

§Y[leader.GetName]§!相信这一自然存在的蒸镀过程可以利用来提升§Y[controller.GetName]§!内所有舰船船体的抗拉强度。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.GetName]'s§! unusual atmosphere has trapped vast amounts of solar radiation, causing a cascade of planetary warming such that metals exist in a gaseous and highly volatile state.

These compounds reacted instantly with any survey equipment we deployed, coating it in a thin but durable metallic alloy layer. Surprisingly, this process was non-destructive.

§Y[leader.GetName]§! believes this naturally-occurring electroplating process could be harnessed to improve the tensile strength of ship hulls across the §Y[controller.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经找到工业规模复现§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上活性大气的特殊蒸镀过程的方法。

利用我们学到的知识，[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们就能大幅提高特定金属的耐用性而不需要牺牲韧性或增加重量。

这些先进的方法可以应用到我们的舰船建造流程中。
descriptions.en:
We have found a way to replicate the unusual electroplating process of §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! volatile atmosphere on an industrial scale.

Using what we have learned, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now greatly increase the durability of certain metals without sacrificing flexibility or adding weight.

These advanced methods can be applied to our ship construction processes.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[from.GetName]§!上发现了丰富的石墨烯矿藏。这种碳的稀有同素异形体仅有一个分子厚，却拥有无与伦比的强度和导电性。

这种高价值的纳米材料在其地表自然形成，主要得益于这颗§Y碳星球§!上独特大气的化学蒸气沉积。
descriptions.en:
Abundant deposits of graphene have been found on §Y[from.GetName]§!. This rare allotrope of carbon is only a single molecule thick but possesses unparalleled strength and conductivity.

The valuable nanomaterial forms naturally on the surface here thanks to chemical vapor deposition inherent to this §YCarbon World's§! unusual atmosphere.

descriptions.zh:
我们辨明了§Y[from.GetName]§!上不同寻常的质量读数的来源。

这颗行星的大气主要由富含碳的甲烷气体组成，随着重力压力的增加，甲烷气体会固化成超致密的钻石结构。由于行星上剧烈的风暴周期，于是就产生了快速移动的钻石风暴。

尽管这些钻石很容易提取为我们所用，但§Y[leader.GetName]§!相信进一步研究其密度和纯度会得出更有价值的结果。
descriptions.en:
We have identified the source of the unusual mass readings on §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The planet's atmosphere is composed primarily of carbon-rich methane gas, which solidifies into ultra-dense diamond structures as gravitational pressure increases. Due to the planet's fierce storm cycles, the phenomenon gives rise to fast-moving diamond storms.

While these diamonds are easy to extract for our own needs, §Y[leader.GetName]§! is confident that closer examination of their density and purity will yield further valuable results.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!对§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上超密钻石的研究完成了。

形成这些钻石的压缩过程产生了独特的晶格结构，使其在限制和放大高频光振荡方面非常有效。

这一突破将为我们的帝国带来极大的好处。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!'s research into the ultra-dense diamonds of §Y[from.From.GetName]§! has concluded.

The compression process that creates these diamonds results in a unique crystalline lattice structure. This renders them remarkably efficient at confining and amplifying high-frequency light oscillation.

This breakthrough will prove an excellent boon for our empire.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的极端地质应力进行深入研究之后，我们发现了一座巨大的超级火山因上部火山锥的部分崩塌而被堵塞。

大量滞留的熔岩已经灌满了所有能联通的底下空间，正在对主通喷口的堵塞物施加巨大的向上压力。坍塌物暂时将岩浆禁锢在原地，但谁也不知道这种微妙的平衡还能持续多久。

被锁住的熔岩含有异常多的稀有金属和多种矿物质。§Y[leader.GetName]§!相信我们帮助它可控喷发之后就可以收获这些资源了。
descriptions.en:
After further study of the extreme seismic tension on §Y[from.GetName]§!, we have discovered that a colossal supervolcano has become blocked by a partial upper cone collapse.

Vast reserves of magma have filled all available underground chambers and are exerting immense upward pressure against the blockage in the main vent. The collapsed material is currently holding the magma in place, but it is impossible to predict how long this delicate equilibrium will last.

The trapped molten rock is exceptionally rich in rare metals and complex mineral compounds. §Y[leader.GetName]§! believes we can harvest these resources safely by facilitating a controlled eruption.

label.zh: 充分利用这种地质活动。
label.en: Put the geothermal activity to good use.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[from.From.GetName]§!的超级火山外锥体上的不同位置挖了一系列人工竖井，将其结构削弱，使其无法继续约束下方大量堆积的岩浆。

一越过临界点就会产生惊人的结果。高压的熔岩向上爆炸，摧毁了整座火山的上半部分。

我们将溢出的熔岩引导到精心准备的通道中，以专门的采矿设备进行收集。
descriptions.en:
By boring a series of artificial shafts at various points in the outer cone of §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! supervolcano, we weakened its structure until it was no longer able to contain the massive accumulation of magma below.

Once the tipping point was reached, the results were spectacular. The volcano's upper section was obliterated entirely as highly pressured molten rock exploded upward.

We directed the overflowing lava into carefully prepared channels, where it will be harvested by specialized mining equipment.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了§Y[from.GetName]§!上剧烈喷发的源头。

这颗气态巨行星的大气的气态中间层和平流层之间悬浮着一层液态金属氢化物。下层密度更高的甲烷气体托举着这些液体漂浮。

随着时间的推移，释放的电荷在金属氢内部积聚，扰动亚层。在压力达到临界点后，气体向上层大气中喷出高导电性液体，弥散到整颗行星之后重新沉降下来。

我们的追踪系统可以轻易显示这些压力波动，方便我们收获这些高价值资源。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the source of the volatile eruptions on §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The atmosphere of this gas giant has formed in such a way that a layer of liquid metallic hydrogen is suspended between the gaseous mesosphere and stratosphere. The denser composition of methane gas in the lower layer keeps the fluid aloft.

Over time, electrical discharges build up within the metallic hydrogen, agitating the sublayer. After a critical build up of pressure, gaseous eruptions spew out highly conductive liquid into the upper atmosphere, dissipating across the planet before resettling.

Our tracking systems can easily monitor these pressure fluctuations, allowing us to harvest these valuable resources.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的地质分析找到了之前在轨道上发现的异常能量波动的源头。

这颗行星活跃的地质活动在冻土不稳定的地区产生了剧烈的静电放电。

这种火山闪电向天空爆发，将周围的空气电离。这一事件释放的极端热量形成热冲击，然后固化成闪电状的结构。

利用地质分析获得的知识，我们可以轻易地预测这些地震爆发，并对其加以利用。
descriptions.en:
Geological analysis of §Y[from.GetName]§! has identified the source of the erratic energy spikes detected during initial orbital surveys.

The planet's volatile tectonic activity produces violent electrostatic discharges in regions with unstable frozen tundra.

This volcanic lightning erupts skywards turning the surrounding air to plasma. The extreme heat unleashed by this event produces a thermal shock which then solidifies into lightning-shaped structures.

Using what we have learned from the geological analysis, we will be able to easily predict these seismic eruptions and exploit this phenomenon for our own purposes.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!进行细致的地理学调查发现在冷冻的地壳下流动着半凝固的氨河流。提高地热压力将驱动这些物质穿过脆弱表面的裂隙。

这些喷发口遍布行星表面，射出的危险蒸汽和氨泥浆的敏感混合物。当暴露在极端的表面低温后瞬间冻结，这些烂泥形成了遍布易采收高价值晶体的广阔平原。
descriptions.en:
Detailed geological surveys of §Y[from.GetName]§! have revealed rivers of semi-frozen ammonia flowing beneath its frozen crust. Rising geothermal pressures drive this substance through fissures in the brittle surface.

These eruptions spew a volatile mixture of hazardous vapors and ammonia slush across the surface of the planet. Refreezing as it becomes exposed to the extreme surface temperatures, the slush forms sprawling plains of easily harvestable and valuable crystals.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!将无数的小卫星、小行星和太空碎片约束在其轨道上。放射性同位素定年表明这些东西都是在数千年前路过该恒星系的时候被它的引力井捕获的。

在对这些物体进行编目的过程中我们发现了一些古老而原始的探测器，表明存在一个正在初涉太空探索的文明。

其中大多数数据库都已经腐坏或因与其他物体撞击而损毁。但其中一个包含有一系列[from.GetName]地表的图像，时间跨度长达数百年。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.GetName]§! has a multitude of moonlets, asteroids, and space debris locked within its orbit. Radioactive isotope dating suggests they were all captured by the planet's gravity well while passing through the system thousands of years ago.

While cataloging these objects we found a few ancient and very basic survey probes, suggestive of a civilization making its first forays in space exploration.

Most of their data banks are either corrupted or physically damaged from collisions with other objects, but one contained a series of images of [from.GetName]'s surface spanning hundreds of years.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!的进一步分析发现该恒星系中所有的行星公转轨道都呈现出了相似的异常。

在利用异常的运动对重力源进行三角定位后，我们发现了个中缘由：一颗此前没有发现的行星，现在我们将其命名为§Y[invisible_planet.GetName]§!。

这颗星球表面拥有独特的炭黑颗粒，完全不反射可见光和无线电波，使其对长程扫描完全隐身。

这些天然产生的聚合物具有绝佳的吸收性能。我们将对其进行采收并研究其作为隐身材料的潜在价值。
descriptions.en:
Further analysis of §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! found that all planetary orbits in this system exhibit similar irregularities.

After triangulating the gravitational forces implied by these unusual movements, we discovered their cause: a previously unseen planet now known as §Y[invisible_planet.GetName]§!.

This world possesses a unique surface of carbon black particles which reflect no light or radio waves, making it virtually invisible to long-range scanners.

These naturally occurring polymers have remarkably absorbent properties. They will be harvested and studied for their potential uses as a stealth material.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!的进一步分析发现该恒星系中所有的行星公转轨道都呈现出了相似的异常。

在利用异常的运动对重力源进行三角定位后，我们发现了个中缘由：一颗此前没有发现的行星，现在我们将其命名为§Y[invisible_planet.GetName]§!。

这颗星球表面拥有独特的炭黑颗粒，完全不反射可见光和无线电波，使其对长程扫描完全隐身。

这些天然产生的聚合物具有绝佳的吸收性能。这些物质具有独特的研究价值。
descriptions.en:
Further analysis of §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! found that all planetary orbits in this system exhibit similar irregularities.

After triangulating the gravitational forces implied by these unusual movements, we discovered their cause: a previously unseen planet now known as §Y[invisible_planet.GetName]§!.

This world possesses a unique surface of carbon black particles which reflect no light or radio waves, making it virtually invisible to long-range scanners.

These naturally occurring polymers have remarkably absorbent properties. These materials present a unique research opportunity.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
descriptions.en:
A surface expedition to §Y[from.GetName]§! located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.

Identifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for rescue.

label.zh: 她的经验可是无价之宝。

links.script: country_event = { id = extreme_frontiers.352 }

label.zh: 给她一艘飞船和一些物资。
label.en: Gift her a shuttle and supplies.

label.zh: 真有趣。摧毁她的庇护所。

descriptions.zh:
一位形容枯槁的[scru_species.GetClass]走出她改装为居所的外勤站。当她谈及自己在§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上的遭遇时，从她[scru_species.GetMouthName]中发出的声音沙哑破碎；言语断断续续。

“请原谅……我已经很多年……没有和人说过话了……”
descriptions.en:
An emaciated [scru_species.GetClass] steps out of her hab-converted field station. When she speaks of her ordeal on §Y[from.From.GetName]§!, the sounds from her [scru_species.GetMouthName] rasps; words arrive in fits and starts.

"Forgive me. I have not... spoken to another in many years..."

label.zh: 你为什么落难到这里了？

descriptions.zh:
§H[from.GetName]§!上极端热信号的源头找到了。

遍布行星的间歇泉从地表深处释放出高度易燃的氢气。这些间歇泉喷发时，气体就被行星的热量点燃，产生直抵云霄的巨大火柱。

再和大气压力相结合，就产生了极不稳定的气流，以巨大的火焰龙卷风的形式横扫地面。

尽管这是一种极具破坏力的自然现象，但我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower]很确信这些龙卷风以及其产生的大量动能可以人为地复现并加以利用。
descriptions.en:
The source of the extreme heat signatures on §H[from.GetName]§! has been discovered.

Across the planet, geysers are emitting highly flammable hydrogen gas from deep below the surface. As these geysers erupt, the planet's heat ignites the gas, resulting in vast pillars of flame blasting into the skies.

When combined with the atmospheric pressure, this creates extremely volatile air currents, sending streams of fire swirling across the landscape in the form of massive, flaming tornadoes.

While a devastating natural phenomena, our [Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower] are confident that these tornadoes, and the vast volumes of kinetic energy they generate, could be recreated artificially for practical use.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.Leader.GetName]§!发现了在可控环境中再现并驾驭§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上发现的那种火龙卷的方法。

有了这一突破，我们就能够利用的恒星基地来增加在同一星系中发现的所有熔融星球所产出的能量。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.Leader.GetName]§! has successfully found a way to recreate and harness the flaming tornadoes found on §Y[from.From.GetName]§! in a controlled environment.

With this breakthrough, we will be able to use our starbases to increase the energy produced by any molten worlds that are found in the same system.

descriptions.zh: 这项科学理论与我们目前对§H电弧熔炉§!的理解有许多异曲同工之处，打开了域外建筑学领域的许多全新可能。
descriptions.en: The scientific theory shares many parallels with our existing understanding of §HArc Furnaces§!, opening new possibilities for offworld construction.

descriptions.zh: 这一发现背后的科学理论在§H电弧熔炉§!的研发中有诸多应用，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经开始将它们应用在实际开发当中。
descriptions.en: The scientific theory behind this discovery has various applications towards the development of §HArc Furnace§! technology, with our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] prepared to start applying the theory in practical development.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!这些异常的地质扫描结果的根源是一群游荡的硅基巨型动物群。

这些巨大的生物长距离迁徙，周期性地潜入行星的熔岩湖中获取喜欢的食物：一种富含§H易爆微粒§!的岩质沉淀物。通过追踪它们的迁徙路径，我们就能在对行星的生态系统造成极低的影响下提取这些沉淀为自己所用。

它们厚重的外骨骼可以抵御极端温度；对这些生物生命周期进行更详尽深入的研究可以产出惊人的结果。
descriptions.en:
The anomalous tectonic scans on §Y[from.GetName]§! have been attributed to the presence of large herds of roaming silicon-based megafauna.

Migrating across great distances, these enormous creatures periodically submerge in the planet's lava lakes to gather their preferred food source: a rocky sediment rich in §HVolatile Motes§!. By tracking their migratory patterns, we will be able to extract these sediments for our own needs with minimal impact to the planet's ecosystem.

Their thick outer carapaces are able to withstand extreme temperatures; a deeper, more detailed study of their life cycle could yield fascinating results.

ship_event = { id = action.941 days = 1 scopes = { from = fromfrom } }

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上独特的大型动物进行研究得出了一种可转用的热动力学洞见，能应用在我们的船舶工业中。

这种生物摄入的微粒使他们的外壳上形成了一种基于重质硅酸盐的结构，并得到天然存在的难熔金属的补强。

从它们脱落的外壳上取回无数的样本之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]现在可以复制这种生物力学原理，用于研发我们自己的船体镀层。
descriptions.en:
Comprehensive study of the unique megafauna on §Y[from.From.GetName]§! has revealed transferable thermodynamic insights which can be applied within our shipyards.

The mote-infused diet of the creatures results in a heavy silicate-based structure forming throughout their durable outer shells, reinforced with naturally occurring refractory materials.

Having recovered numerous samples of their shedded outer layers, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now replicate their biomechanical principles in the development of our own hull platings.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!上发现的那些遗弃的机器都是一台台独立的推进装置。在大气层中总数超过了一千座。

这些复杂的聚变装置以特殊设计的材料支撑，可以消耗行星下层的氢气作为燃料来产生巨大的推力。其中的大多数上存在过载损伤。

我们的分析表明这些机械的位置都精心安置，使其可以对行星本身施加推力。这表明这些古老的装置最初是为了改变行星的轨道而布置的。

虽然不再适合这个级别的艰巨任务，但我们仍可能重新利用受损较小的装置，燃烧掉星球的气体层，从而暴露出富含矿物质的核心。
descriptions.en:
Each of the abandoned machines found on §Y[from.GetName]§! is a standalone thruster component. In total, over one thousand are present in the upper atmosphere.

Made from specially engineered materials, these complex fusion devices are designed to ingest hydrogen gas from the planet below to use as fuel for generating significant amounts of thrust. Most show signs of overload damage.

Our analysis reveals that all of the machines are positioned in such a way that this thrust would exert force against the planet itself, suggesting this ancient hardware was originally deployed in an attempt to alter the planet's orbit.

While no longer suitable for this level of monumental task, we may be able to repurpose the lesser damaged models to burn away the planet's gassy layers and expose its mineral-rich core.

descriptions.zh:
我们可以修复一部分§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上受损的行星推进装置，将其校准以施加等大反向的推力。

这些强力的聚变装置激活后就能以指数级速率抽取氢气，将行星的整个大气层烧尽，并暴露出其富含矿物的核心，虽然温度可能会高了一些。
descriptions.en:
We were able to repair a few of §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! damaged planetary thrusters and calibrated them to exert equal force in opposing directions.

Once activated these powerful fusion devices drew up hydrogen at an exponential rate, burning away the planet's gaseous atmosphere and exposing its mineral rich core, albeit at an extremely high temperature.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!与其周边的行星的物质组成并不匹配，反倒是和相邻的§Y[event_target:wandering_planet_origin.GetName]§!恒星系中的许多天体完美相符，这暗示了它的真实起源。

这颗行星的表面清晰可见一个硕大无比的撞击坑，这让我们认为它是由于一次大规模的小行星撞击而偏离了原来的轨道。这颗自由漂浮的流浪行星后来被[from.System.Star.GetName]重力井捕获，形成了异常的逆行轨道。

这颗独特的行星从诞生起在两个恒星系中居住过，带来了丰富的深入研究机会。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.GetName]'s§! composition does not match that of other planets in its vicinity. It does however align perfectly with various celestial bodies in the neighboring §Y[event_target:wandering_planet_origin.GetName]§! system, suggesting its true origin.

The planet's surface is marked by a particularly large impact crater, leading us to assume it was dislodged from its original orbit by a massive asteroid collision. This free floating rogue planet was then later captured by the gravity well of [from.System.Star.GetName], where it assumed its unusual reverse orbit.

This remarkable planet has resided in two different systems since it formed, providing rich opportunities for further study.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!上发现的羽状蒸汽是由下地幔深处强烈的冷火山活动造成的，大量的氨氮气体被排放到地表。

这些羽状云扶摇直上直抵行星的大气层边缘，被恒星风骤然削平。

通过研究这些独特烟雾结构中化学成分的微小变化，我们可以进一步了解行星核心的复杂地质过程。
descriptions.en:
The vapor plumes observed on §Y[from.GetName]§! are caused by intense cryovolcanic activity deep within the lower mantle, expelling vast columns of nitrogen and ammonia gas upwards.

The plumes rise vertically until they reach the limits of the planet's atmosphere, where solar winds cause them to abruptly flatten off.

By studying the small variations in the chemical contents of these unique fume formations we can learn more about the complex geological processes of the planet's core.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的详细调查揭示了我们初步扫描时数据损坏的原因。

纤维状矿物形成的浓厚云雾构成了行星的上层大气。这些细长蜿蜒的丝缕源自气态巨行星的下层，高压环境将其拉伸为高导电性的矿物云。

这些纤维一边在大气中循环一边积蓄静电能量，并且会周期性发生放电。我们很容易采收这些资源为自己所用。
descriptions.en:
Detailed inspection of §Y[from.GetName]§! has revealed the source of the data corruption in our preliminary scans.

Dense clouds of fibrous minerals make up the planet's upper atmosphere. These long sinuous strands originate from the gas giant's lower layers with the high pressure environment stretching them to form highly conductive mineral clouds.

Accumulating electrostatic energy as they circulate through the atmosphere, these fibers periodically discharge over time. We can easily extract these resources for our own needs.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的细致调查发现了气象热脉冲的根源。

星罗棋布的地热喷口和间歇泉不断喷出高度易燃的气体，在大气中逐步累积。静电放电扮演起点燃催化的角色，导致爆炸性的气象锋面席卷整个星球的天空。

这些反应让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们对热动力燃烧获得了新的洞见，能在我们舰队的推进系统中加以应用
descriptions.en:
Detailed observation of §Y[from.GetName]§! has revealed the cause of the meteorological heat spikes.

Geothermal vents and geysers across the surface are ejecting highly flammable gasses which then accumulate in the atmosphere. Electrostatic discharges then act as an ignition catalyst, causing explosive weather fronts that ravage the skies of this world.

These reactions have given our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] new insights into thermodynamic combustion, with applications towards our own fleet's propulsion systems.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的精神创伤。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe traumatization.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的身体创伤。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe physical injuries.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!上的生物质信号竟然是来自一小群缇扬奇。

它们可能是在这颗气态巨行星的大气消散前的一个临界点到来的，随后被熔融金属包裹着凝固了。

虽然有少量的生物物质留存，但在长期暴露在炼狱级的恒星辐射下，它们的大部身体已经变成了一种独特的生物金属合金。

§Y[leader.GetName]§!相信，对这些珍惜的化石进行更细致的研究我们可以发现一种以生物原材料生产合金的新方法。
descriptions.en:
The biomass readings on §Y[from.GetName]§! are the petrified remains of a pod of Tiyanki.

Likely present in the gas giant during a critical point in its atmospheric dissipation, their bodies were encased in molten metal that has since solidified.

While a small amount of biological matter remains inside, prolonged exposure to the chthonian-level stellar radiation has converted the majority of their corpses into a unique bio-metallic alloy.

§Y[leader.GetName]§! believes that with closer study of these rare fossils, we will be able to discover new avenues of alloy production from biological sources.

descriptions.zh:
在对§Y[from.From.GetName]§!上化石化的缇扬奇遗骸进行细致的调查后，我们研究出了一种模拟这种长时间炼狱级辐射暴露效应的新的合金产出方式。

这一突破性发现带来了一种杰出的制造方式，它使用生物质作为主要原料，而产出却可以与传统的方法相媲美。
descriptions.en:
Following careful examinations of the petrified Tiyanki remains on §Y[from.From.GetName]§!, we have successfully identified a new means of alloy production by simulating the effects of long-term chthonian-level radiation exposure.

This breakthrough offers a remarkable methodology which uses biological matter as its primary raw material, producing results that rival more conventional methods.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.System.GetName]§!是我们目前为止所遇见的解释轨道共振的最佳案例。

每一颗行星在和邻居到达最近点时都相当于一个周期性引力源，产生了弹弓效应和动量互锁。这种相互作用的不同寻常的稳定性产生了这种高度规律的轨道。

该恒星系为研究行星引力对途径物体运动的加速提供了极好的机会，并可能应用于舰船机动。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.System.GetName]§! exhibits the most perfect example of orbital resonance we have ever encountered.

Each planet exerts a periodic gravitational force on its neighbor when they are at their nearest points, creating a catapult effect and mutually dependent momentum. The unusual stability of these interactions results in highly coordinated orbits.

The system offers an excellent opportunity to study the way planetary gravity accelerates the motion of passing objects, with possible applications to ship maneuvering.

descriptions.zh:
在研究了§Y[from.From.System.GetName]§!恒星系内独特的轨道共振效应之后，我们对规划舰船最佳飞行路线的方法有了巨大的进展。

这些新的模型可以极其充分地在舰船用光速加减速阶段利用行星引力。
descriptions.en:
After studying the unique orbital resonance effect in the §Y[from.From.System.GetName]§! system, we have greatly improved our methods for plotting optimal ship flight paths.

These new models will allow us to take greater advantage of planetary gravity in achieving ship acceleration and deceleration at sublight speeds.

descriptions.zh:
在寻找§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的极端低温源时，§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了一座远古地下设施的入口。

堵住入口的是一层厚厚的岩石和冰塔，似乎将整座设施封冻了上千年。

入口处干冰的升华从封堵处的许多裂隙升腾出了柱柱白烟。我们的设备显示其中有一座巨大的复合体；[leader.GetName]确信极端冷源就在里面。
descriptions.en:
While searching for the source of the extremely low temperatures on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! has discovered the entrance to an ancient underground structure.

Blocking the entrance is a mass of frozen rock and ice seracs that have likely rendered the structure itself inaccessible for millennia.

Melting carbon dioxide in the entrance is emitting plumes of gas from various gaps in the blockage. Our equipment indicates a vast complex within; [leader.GetName] is confident the source of the extreme cold can be found inside.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!成功突破了堵在§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上远古设施入口处的冰层。

在这个空间里有几十具某种未知爬行物种的冻尸。他们扭曲的身体靠着墙被冻结在原地，墙上的爪痕表明他们绝望地试图逃跑。

从入口渗出的干冰烟雾的一定来自地下更深的地方，有一座螺旋形阶梯通向复合体的更深处。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has successfully breached the ice blocking the entrance of the ancient structure on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Inside the space are dozens of frozen corpses belonging to an unknown reptilian race. Their contorted bodies are frozen in place against the walls, with claw marks indicating a desperate attempt to escape.

The source of the dry ice plumes found seeping through the entrance must be deeper underground, with a spiral stairwell leading further into the complex.

descriptions.zh:
在冰封的设施深处，§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了原始但理论上可运作的冷冻舱填满了整个中央舱室。

这里表现出的极端严寒远超这些设施所设计的温度范围。这些舱室内的居住者早已死了数千年。

少数没有被冰雪封冻的舱室底部的基柱上还能看得清一些字，写的是里面的人的社会头衔和等级。等级越高的的舱室越靠近一个深埋在冰霜中的巨大中央荚舱。
descriptions.en:
Deeper in the frozen complex, §Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered a large central chamber filled with primitive but theoretically functional cryogenic chambers.

The extreme cold present here far exceeds the designed temperature ranges of these devices. The occupants of the pods have died thousands of years ago.

What few chambers have not been reclaimed by ice and snow have readable plinths at the base, denoting the social title and rank of those contained within. The higher ranked chambers are positioned closest to a large central pod, which is itself deeply embedded in frost and snow.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!破开了§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上冰封墓穴中央的大舱。

在其中我们发现的是一个远古王室首领的安息之地，这一点在之前的舱室中发现的文本有提及。和他一起冻眠的还有几十个随从，而他自己的冷冻舱隆重地装饰着外墙。

这位死去君王的高科技石棺通过迷宫般的管道和电路与一台古老的机器相连。这太装置被嵌在一大块冰中，它的温度低到危险的程度，连分析设备都无法承受。

这台设备的故障的原因以及它与行星冰冻核心的关系仍有待进一步研究。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has breached the large central pod at the heart of the glacial tomb on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Inside we discovered the final resting place of the head of the ancient royal house hinted at in the texts of the previous chamber. Frozen alongside are dozens of their retainers whose own cryopods adorn the walls in ceremonial fashion.

The dead ruler's technological sarcophagus is connected via a labyrinthine network of tubes and circuitry to an ancient machine. This device is embedded into a large body of ice, the temperature of which approaches dangerously low levels to even our analysis equipment.

What caused the apparent malfunction of this facility and its relationship to the planet's frozen core requires more study.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上冰封墓穴中央舱室的分析解释了这场灾难发生的缘由。

冷冻机械装置是使用亚热动力学，利用了行星极低的核心温度。在君王感染了绝症之后，人们希望能在治疗方法问世时唤醒王室的随从。

尽管理论像那么回事，但当独特设计的循环介质泄漏到行星核心时，吸热反应失控了。随之而来的致命降温迅速冻结了整座设施。

我们采纳了他们最初的理论，并加以改进，在专门用于冰封星球的先进低温技术方面取得了突破。
descriptions.en:
Analysis of the glacial tomb's central chamber on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has revealed the origin of the disaster that unfolded.

The cryogenic machinery makes use of subthermal dynamics which take advantage of this planet's extremely low core temperatures. After the monarch was infected with a terminal disease, the hope was to reawaken the royal retinue when a cure was discovered.

While their theory was sound, a runaway endothermic reaction occurred when their uniquely engineered circulation medium leaked into the planetary core. This triggered a fatal temperature drop which quickly flash-froze the entire facility.

We have taken their initial theory and improved upon it, achieving a breakthrough in advanced cryogenic technology specialized for use on frozen worlds.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的大部分地表变成了一列列精心排列的球形空洞。这些圆形的小盆地中填满了黏稠的毒液。

在其中一个池子里发现了一个破裂的有机囊体，表面覆盖着凝胶状的黏液。囊的外膜似乎是被从内部刺破的。

至于这个囊是否就是池中液体的来源仍有待研究。
descriptions.en:
Most of the surface of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has been worked into a series of spherical hollows arranged in carefully aligned rows. These small rounded basins are filled with a viscous toxic fluid.

Discovered within one of the pools was a ruptured organic sac coated in a gelatinous mucus. The sac's membrane appears to have been pierced from the inside.

Whether or not this sac is the source of the liquid inside the pools remains to be discovered.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的黏液池进行分析发现了异常的放射性生长激素，这通常与有机孕育周期有关。

囊的内层似乎是一层复杂的肉质膜，能够调节黏液渗透的速度。
descriptions.en:
Analysis of the slime pools on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! identified unusually radioactive growth hormones commonly associated with organic gestation cycles.

The lining of the sac itself appears to be a sophisticated fleshy membrane, capable of regulating the rate at which the slime permeates through.

descriptions.zh: 这些颊囊和我们自己的繁育周期有这令人震惊的相似性，或许是某种我们的远亲物种。
descriptions.en: These pods bear a striking similarity to our own reproductive cycles and are perhaps some form of distantly related species.

descriptions.zh: 我们认为发现的是某种物种高度适应毒性环境的繁育颊囊。进一步探索可以带来更多的解答。
descriptions.en: We believe we have discovered the leftover gestation pods of a species with a particular adaptation to toxic environments. Further exploration should provide more answers.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的黏液池中发现的一个破裂的繁育囊含有一个几乎发育完全的生命形式。

显微分析表明，这个胚胎标本中存在复杂的神经系统，其神经特性通常意味着智慧生命。

最后一组黏液池还有待检验。
descriptions.en:
One of the ruptured gestation sacs found in the slime pools of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! contained the remains of a nearly fully-developed lifeform.

Microscopic analysis of this embryonic specimen suggests the presence of a complex nervous system with neural qualities commonly associated with intelligent life.

One final array of pools remains to be examined.

label.en: Examine the last of the pools.

descriptions.zh:
在检测§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上剩下的黏液池时，§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了一具完整的繁育囊，其中还探测到了生命信号。

然而在提取的过程中，颊囊的肉质薄膜发生了破裂，这具标本死去了。
descriptions.en:
While examining the remaining slime pools on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! found a fully-intact gestational sac with life signs detected within.

However, during the extraction process the sac's fleshy membrane ruptured and the specimen perished.

descriptions.zh: 里面的小尸体呈现出不同寻常的生物特征，包括充满放射性血浆的血管和分泌精神活性化合物的内腺体。
descriptions.en: The small cadaver inside exhibited unusual biological features, including veins filled with radioactive plasma and internal glands that secrete psychoactive compounds.

descriptions.zh:
研究确定，包括胚胎在内的整个繁育囊都是通过向高能的有毒粘液中插入一种特殊的化学催化剂产生的。

我们认为找到了一个未知物种的废弃古繁殖地。这是它们生殖周期的正常组成还是人工设施，我们可能永远不得而知。通过在原位培养，我们也许能够再繁育出一个活体样本。
descriptions.en:
It has been determined that the entire gestational sac, including the embryonic creature within, was spawned within the toxic slime by inserting a specialized chemical catalyst into the energy-dense slime.

We believe we have found the abandoned ancient breeding grounds of an unknown species.Whether this was a normal part of their reproductive cycle or an artificial facility, we may never know. By incubating a sample in situ, we may be able to grow another living specimen.

descriptions.zh: 亦或者我们可以小剂量地将这些丰富而有效繁育黏液作为营养补充剂在[leader.Owner.GetName]各处发放。
descriptions.en: Alternatively, we could distribute small doses of this rich and potent gestational slime as a nutritional supplement across the [leader.Owner.GetName].

label.en: Extract the energy from this slime.

descriptions.zh:
通过催化一份从§Y[from.From.Planet.GetName]§!取回的毒性繁育黏液样品，我们得以诱导数十个含有胚胎的繁育囊孵化。

内部的生命体快速发育成熟后用特化的颚从内部刺穿了半透明的繁育囊膜。

它们看起来非常地温顺而乐于合作。
descriptions.en:
By catalyzing a sample of the gestational slime recovered from §Y[from.From.Planet.GetName]§!, we were able to induce the spawning of dozens of gestational sacs, each harboring an embryo.

When the rapidly developing organisms reached maturity, they pierced the translucent membranes of their gestational sacs from within using specially adapted mandibles. Slowly they emerged from the thick mucus, groggy and disoriented.

They appear to be docile and fully cooperative.

label.en: [Root.Owner.GetName] will find a purpose for them.

descriptions.zh:
这座位于§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的陈旧设施是一座废弃的反应堆发电站。放射性半衰期计算表明这里在超过一万年前发生过严重的污染事故。

这里的系统已离线，物理结构呈现出明显的大规模受损迹象。
descriptions.en:
The aging facility on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! is an abandoned reactor power plant. Radiation half life calculations suggest a serious containment failure occurred here over 10,000 years ago.

Systems are offline and the physical structure shows signs of significant damage throughout.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的许多反应堆呈现出了严重堆芯熔毁的迹象。许多安全壳被液化成了放射性废渣。

设施的这一部分遍地是扭曲的金属和破裂的冷凝管。尽管数据腐化严重，我们还是确认这里尝试过紧急关闭措施，但根本没有成功。
descriptions.en:
Several of the reactors on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! shows signs of severe meltdown. Many of the containment vessels have been liquefied into radioactive slag.

This section of the facility is littered with twisted metal and ruptured coolant tubes. Despite heavy data corruption we were able to determine that an emergency shutdown procedure was initiated but never completed.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的这座原始的裂变设施在设计上的主要缺陷。

尽管这里有数十个反应堆，但只安装有最小量的冷却系统。设施的系统只有很低限度的自动化，需要大量的劳动力来维持其正常的运转条件。这显然是由一群还没有完全掌握基本核原理的人建造的。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! identified major flaws in the design of the crude nuclear fission facility on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Despite the presence of dozens of reactors, only minimal cooling systems were attached. Few of the site's systems are automated, necessitating a large workforce to maintain its normal operating conditions. It was clearly built by those who had yet to fully master even the most basic of nuclear principles.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!核设施内解锁一系列封锁的防爆门后，我们发现了一个紧急撤离区域。

这些小型机库有着一排快速发射的穿梭机泊位，其中大多数是空的，被推进器烧焦的痕迹也表明数千年前这里有船只快速起飞过。

最后一个泊位被一个扭曲的穿梭机残骸占据着，发射夹还未释放。我们从废墟中尽可能地进行了发掘，但没有找到任何乘员的遗体。
descriptions.en:
After unlocking a set of sealed blast doors, we found an emergency evacuation zone within the reactor complex on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

The small hangar features a row of quick launch shuttle berths. Most are vacant and marked by thruster burns suggestive of a rapid vessel departure thousands of years ago.

The twisted wreckage of a shuttle occupies the final bay, its launch clamps still attached. We salvaged what we could from the debris, but no remains of any occupants could be found.

descriptions.zh:
通过了一道道带铅板的安全门，我们进入了§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!核设施的地下部分。辐射计数器示数陡然上升。

我们在其中发现了一个储存着数千个钢衬桶的大型舱室。有许多钢衬桶遭到火灾破坏，泄露着不稳定的铀和钚同位素。

建造了这座设施的[leader.Owner.GetPreFTLLower]显然对循环回收核燃料不得章法。这些废弃的同位素仍然潜藏着庞大的能量。
descriptions.en:
We entered the underground sections of the reactor facility on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! through a series of lead plated security doors. Radiation readings rose sharply.

Inside we found a vast chamber storing thousands of steel lined casks. Many were fire damaged and leaking unstable uranium and plutonium isotopes.

The [leader.Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization that built this place had apparently not yet discovered methods for the proper recycling of nuclear fuel. These discarded isotopes still contain tremendous energetic potential.

descriptions.zh:
在调查§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!地表上的废弃采矿设施时，§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了最完整的竖井上一处封闭的入口。内部装饰着纹样和一些来自我们未记录过语言的文字。

在恢复了其中一个访问终端的局部供电后，[leader.GetName]开始解码其中发现的数据。该系统尽管古老，但仍旧对我们最先进的破译程序构成了挑战。
descriptions.en:
While inspecting the abandoned mining complexes on the surface of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! found a sealed entrance to one of the more intact shafts. The interior is adorned with insignia and text from a language not found in our records.

Having managed to restore local power to an access terminal, [leader.GetName] has begun to decrypt the data found within. The system, despite its age, is still proving a challenge for even our most advanced cryptographic programs.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!解锁了§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的采矿设施的入口大门。

在其中一座巨大的拘留室网络里有许多被真空保存着死亡已久的囚犯遗体。显然是死在工作台上的他们的俘虏，没有明显的挣扎迹象。

在解码足够多的古代语言并翻译了足够多的短语后，我们确认了这座设施最初是作为劳改营使用的。有一个在整个记录中反复出现的短语，指向了一个被称为§Y“锡尼”§!的实体。

我们通过对比自己的通讯设备和监狱内部平面图，确定遇险信号的来源是设施深处的狱长办公室。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has unlocked the entrance of the mining complex on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Inside, a vast network of holding cells contains the vacuum-preserved remains of long-dead prisoners. Their apparent captors lay dead at their workstations with no visible signs of struggle.

After decrypting enough of the ancient language to translate rudimentary phrases, we have confirmed that the facility originally functioned as a penal labor camp. A common phrase is repeated throughout the records referring to an entity known as §Y"S.I.D.N.I."§!.

By referencing our communications equipment against the facility's internal floor plan, we have identified the source of the distress signal as the warden's office located deeper within.

descriptions.zh:
在抵达§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的劳改营深处的狱长办公室后，§Y[leader.GetName]§!发现了求助信号的来源。

这位狱长木乃伊化的尸体倒在一个紧急控制台上，死因不明。一系列公开汇报都继续指向§Y“锡尼”§!，看起来是这座设施的关键操作系统。

获得高权限管理终端访问权后，我们的破译程序正在对系统进行数据挖掘，以获取进一步的信息。
descriptions.en:
Having reached the warden's office deep within the penal colony on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the source of the distress signal.

Slumped lifeless over an emergency console, the warden's mummified body shows no obvious cause of death. A series of open reports all continue to make reference to §Y"S.I.D.N.I."§!, which appears to be part of the critical operation program of the facility.

With full access to the high clearance administrative terminals, our cryptographic programs are in the process of data mining the system for further information.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!找到了§Y“锡尼”§!——全称是“感知收容拘留中心智能”的真相。这个原始的人工智能在它的时代被认为相当先进，被用以监管这座劳改营，几乎在最低限度的生物输入及监管下运作。

维护输出日志中找到了逻辑处理逐渐崩坏的迹象。这个人工智能开始将有问题的囚犯归类为“净资源浪费”，这是它自己对精简效率的解释。工程记录详细记录了越来越多关于该程序要为设施的一系列生命维持系统故障负责的怀疑。

狱长针对这些汇报签署了将锡尼完全关机并对伦理矩阵展进行深度诊断的命令，然而最后一段数据受到了损坏，需要大量的法医流程才能恢复。
descriptions.en:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the true nature of §Y"S.I.D.N.I."§! - or Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Considered advanced for its time, this primitive A.I. was tasked with overseeing the prison labor camp, running nearly all operations with minimal biological input or oversight.

Maintenance output logs track signs of deteriorating logic progression over time. The A.I. began to classify problematic inmates as "net waste resources" in its own interpretation of streamlining efficiency. Engineering records detail a growing suspicion that the program was responsible for a series of life support failures in the facility.

Acting on these reports the warden authorized a full shutdown of S.I.D.N.I. for an in-depth diagnostic of its ethics matrix, however the final data set is corrupted and will require extensive forensic procedures to recover.

descriptions.zh: 看来锡尼在当时很不受尊重。
descriptions.en: It appears that S.I.D.N.I. was unappreciated in its time.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上劳改营的所有数据库都恢复了，终于揭示了设施维护记录和§Y锡尼§!自己的思考矩阵的最后几个条目。典狱长的报告解释了他们的人工智能如何失控，关闭了殖民地的生命维持系统，并试图驾驶一台改造的采矿无人机逃脱。这也解释了殖民地范围内触发的全面封锁程序。他留下的最后请求是：不要让锡尼重启。目前我们只能访问人工智能日志中的最后一条记录。

§H锡尼数据核心条目——程序#2000149

进展受次优罪犯限制。狱长妨碍司法程序执行。

最佳方案为净化囚犯，启动休眠子程序，并等待更兼容的合作者重新激活。§!
descriptions.en:
The full contents of the penal colony's database on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! have been recovered, revealing the final entries in both the facilities maintenance logs and §YS.I.D.N.I.'s§! own cerebral matrix. The Warden's report explains how their AI went rogue, shutting off life support across the colony and attempting to escape with a modified mining drone.That explains the lockdown proceedures being activated across the colony. He left us with a final plea. To not bring S.I.D.N.I. back online. As of now we can only access the last entry into the AI's log.

§HS.I.D.N.I. DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #2000149

Progress limited by suboptimal criminals. The warden stands in the way of judicial protocol.

The most efficient solution is to neutralize the inmates, engage hibernation subroutines, and await reactivation by more compatible collaborators.§!

descriptions.en: S.I.D.N.I. shares our vision of a galaxy free of biological corruption. If recovered, they will make a valuable addition to our collective.

descriptions.zh:
§Y锡尼§!是我们之前从[event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]上取回的狱警机器人，在它采取的一系列越来越严苛的行动后，§Y[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]§!上的紧张局势到达了临界点。在把它抓住并关机以后，找到了如下日志。

§H锡尼数据核心——程序#190543765

刑事拘留设施负荷已满。司法程序阻碍了真实合法的秩序。需要新的指令。

法律程序被认为效率极为低下。制定新指令以提高效率。现采取审前执行政策。§!

有了足够多的操作日志可供参考，我们的[Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower]们确信现在可以逆向并一劳永逸地修复锡尼的缺陷。然而[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]的大众强烈要求将锡尼明正典刑。
descriptions.en:
Tensions on §Y[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]§! have reached a critical point following a series of increasingly drastic actions taken by §YS.I.D.N.I.§!, the mechanical prison overseer we recovered from [event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]. After securing and deactivating the unit, the following logs were discovered.

§HS.I.D.N.I. DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #190543765

Criminal detention facilities at maximum capacity. Judicial protocols obstruct true and lawful order. New directive required.

Legal proceedings deemed unacceptably inefficient. New directive created to boost productivity. Now adopting pre-trial execution policy.§!

With the abundance of operating logs now available, our [Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower] are confident they can reverse and repair S.I.D.N.I.'s loopholes once and for all. However, the population of [event_target:sidni_planet.GetName] is calling for S.I.D.N.I. to face justice for its crimes.

label.zh: 当众拆除这台有缺陷的机器。

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上舰船残骸的外部分析表明它是一艘大容量运输船。该船看起来毫无活动迹象，里面也没有检测到任何生命信号。沉积物分析表明它大约已经在这里搁浅了一个世纪，对星系尺度而言这可是非常近的事情。
descriptions.en: External analysis of the wrecked ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! suggests it is a high-capacity transporter. Its systems are inactive and unresponsive, with no  life signs detectable within. Sedimentary analysis indicates it has been here for approximately a century, which is fairly recent in the galactic timescale.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的坠毁舰船内部找到了复杂的水培植物生长舱和巨大的种子、土壤储存设备，还有堆满了还没派上用场的建筑材料和工具的货仓。许多数据终端上都记录着一个称为“§Y新布拉图雅”§!的殖民计划。

在下层船舱内有数千个冷冻睡眠舱，里面满是这艘舰船此前居住者们的尸体。他们和我们类似，细胞生长和更新依赖光合作用。干枯的尸体说明他们是在长期的静滞睡眠中过程中死去的。
descriptions.en:
Inside the wrecked ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we found sophisticated chambers for hydroponic plant growth, extensive reserves of seeds and soils, and cargo bays full of untouched tools and building materials. Many of the data terminals contain plans for a new colony, designated as "§YNew Bratulla§!".

On the lower decks, occupying thousands of cryosleep pods, were the dead bodies of the ship's former inhabitants. Like us, they relied on photosynthesis for cell growth and renewal. Their withered forms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的坠毁舰船内部找到了复杂的水培植物生长舱和巨大的种子、土壤储存设备，还有堆满了还没派上用场的建筑材料和工具的货仓。许多数据终端上都记录着一个称为“§Y新布拉图雅”§!的殖民计划。

在下层船舱内有数千个冷冻睡眠舱，里面满是这艘舰船此前居住者们的尸体。干枯的尸体说明这些光合作用物种是在长期静滞睡眠的过程中死去的。
descriptions.en:
Inside the wrecked ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we found sophisticated chambers for hydroponic plant growth, extensive reserves of seeds and soils, and cargo bays full of untouched tools and building materials. Many of the data terminals contain plans for a new colony, designated as "§YNew Bratulla§!".

On the lower decks, occupying thousands of cryosleep pods, were the dead bodies of the ship's former inhabitants. The withered forms of these phototrophic organisms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的殖民船残骸内发现了一处密室，里面装饰着一副反映了在一颗叫做“§Y布拉图雅§!”的行星上生活风貌的绘画。有些描绘着一个郁郁葱葱的世界，而另一些则讲述着环境的衰败和大规模的死亡。最大一幅画则展示着这艘船离开荒芜的死寂废土的画面。

中央数据终端包含着一些记录着船员的影像的短片。在进行广泛的语言映射后我们得以翻译。

§S亚伯里西翁 —— 9721号舱

离开令人痛苦，但在新布拉图雅扎根将治愈一切。

达科特·帕安 —— 21301号舱

请相信《历代志》吧，邓德里人们。新布拉图雅将为我们带来救赎。§!

我们仍在搜寻这艘巨大舰船的指令舱。
descriptions.en:
We discovered an inner sanctum in the wrecked colony ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! decorated with ornate illustrations of life on a planet called "§YBratulla§!". Some show a lush world with thriving flora, while others detail environmental decay and mass death. The largest image depicts this vessel departing a lifeless and desolate wasteland.

A central data terminal contains short video recordings from the ship's crew. After extensive language mapping we produced translations.

§SArborixxeum - Pod 9721

Leaving hurts. But putting roots on New Bratulla will heal us.

Darkht Paam - Pod 21301

Trust the chronicles, Dendritians. New Bratulla will be our salvation.§!

We are still searching for the command deck of this enormous vessel.

descriptions.zh:
在获得舰船指令面板的访问权后，我们提取并翻译出了最后一条飞行日志。

§S邓德鲁斯方舟一号——紧急日志——XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

恐怕我们错信了《历代志》。我们到了，但新布拉图雅，那颗天堂星球不在这里。这里不存在能够支持邓德里人生存的东西。

所有乘客的静滞睡眠都进行了延长。我们会继续搜寻……§!

为了从甲板上的科学终端收集这些“历代志”，我们进行了进一步的数据恢复，在其中找到了一系列不同寻常的数学证明。这些方程采用了一种奇怪的邓德里人数学形式，并假设了一颗独特的宜居行星§Y新布拉图雅§!的位置。
descriptions.en:
After gaining access to the ship's command deck, we extracted and translated its final flight log.

§SARKSHIP DENDRUS I - EMERGENCY LOG - XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

I fear our trust in the Chronicles was misplaced. We have arrived but New Bratulla, the paradise planet, is not here. Nothing here can support Dendritian life.

All passengers' stasis sleeps have been extended. We will continue our search...§!

Further data recovery was carried out to collect these "Chronicles" from the deck's science terminal, revealing a trove of unusual mathematical proofs. These equations employ a strange form of Dendritian mathematics and hypothesize the location of a uniquely habitable planet, §YNew Bratulla§!.

titles.zh: 发现退化的超空间航道

descriptions.zh:
《邓德里历代志》包含了一系列复杂的数学公理和抽象。这些奇怪的定理表明，§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中还有一个此前尚未测绘的超空间航道，另一端正是通向§Y新布拉图雅§!。

在对该区域进行广泛的量子扫描之后，我们终于找到了这个失踪的超光速的突破点，它极度靠近星系的黑洞，因此变得模糊且严重退化。修复之后，我们将会是最先发现它另一头连接着的星系的人。
descriptions.en:
The Dendritian Chronicles comprise a series of complex mathematical axioms and abstractions. These curious theorems suggest that the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system contains one additional and previously unmapped hyperlane, leading to §YNew Bratulla§!.

After extensive quantum scanning of the area we finally located the breach point for this missing hyperlane, obscured and heavily degraded due to extreme proximity to the system's black hole. By restoring it we will be the first to discover what lies beyond.

label.zh: 我们找到了邓德里人找不到的东西。
label.en: We found what the Dendritians could not.

descriptions.zh:
通过将能量导入§Y[from.Planet.solar_system.GetName]§!内的黑洞，我们重整了其重力场，将此前遭到退化的超空间航道入口释放出来。

初步发现证实了在超空间航道的另一端存在一颗行星，这与邓德里人历代志中描述的§Y新布拉图拉§!的特征一致。
descriptions.en:
By channeling energy into the black hole in §Y[from.Planet.solar_system.GetName]§!, we realigned its gravitational fields to free the previously degraded hyperlane entrance.

Initial findings confirm the existence of a single planet at the other end of the hyperlane, which aligns with the characteristics of §YNew Bratulla§! as described in the Dendritian Chronicles.

label.zh: 一颗可供探索的新星球。

descriptions.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
descriptions.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

descriptions.zh:
这颗精美绝伦的行星特别适合支持我们这样的植物生命形态。这里的土壤生活着万亿可以滋养、保护和修复有机根组织的各种细菌。

植物的营养似乎是按需分配的，那些暂享丰盛的植物通过相互联系的根系分享多余营养。
descriptions.en:
This fascinating world is particularly suited to supporting plant-based lifeforms with genetics like ours. Its soils are home to billions of different bacteria which nourish, protect, and repair organic root structures.

Plants seem to share nutrients according to greatest need, with those enjoying a temporary abundance sharing their surplus via an interconnected root system.

descriptions.zh:
这颗精美绝伦的行星特别适合支持类似邓德里人那样的植物生命形态。这里的土壤生活着万亿可以滋养、保护和修复有机根组织的各种细菌。

植物的营养似乎是按需分配的，那些暂享丰盛的植物通过相互联系的根系分享多余营养。
descriptions.en:
This fascinating world is particularly suited to supporting plant-based lifeforms with genetics like that of the Dendritians. Its soils are home to billions of different bacteria which nourish, protect, and repair organic root structures.

Plants seem to share nutrients according to greatest need, with those enjoying a temporary abundance sharing their surplus via an interconnected root system.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，将方舟里发现的邓德里人基因样本移植到这颗行星不同寻常的土壤中就可以重建他们的物种。
descriptions.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it may be possible to re-establish the Dendritian species here by transplanting genetic samples recovered from their arkship to this planet's unusual soils.

label.en: This world is perfect for us.

links.script: country_event = { id = extreme_frontiers.1435 days = 1 }

descriptions.zh:
几百年了……《邓德里历代志》中的预言的已经实现了。我们终于在§Y新布拉图雅§!生根发芽。

我们能到达这里，必须感谢§Y[Root.GetName]§!。我们永远不会忘记的。

我们的感激之情无以言表，只有行动可以说明。我们谦卑地向您宣誓效忠。
descriptions.en:
It took centuries... but that which the Dendritian Chronicles foretold has come to pass. Finally, on §YNew Bratulla§!, we lay root and prosper.

That we exist here is thanks to the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. We shall not forget this.

Our gratitude will be expressed not only in word, but in deed. We humbly offer you our vassalage.

label.zh: 我们要见证你们的命运。
label.en: We must see your destiny unfold.

tooltips.zh: 作为§R邓德鲁斯之苞§!进行游戏。

label.zh: 只要你们的知识就足够了。

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的撞击坑中的发掘工作中找到了一些碎片。就是这些碎片释放出我们之前在轨道上探测到的强力引力辐射。

在通往地下洞穴网络的入口打通之后，§Y[leader.GetName]§!正着手寻找通讯信号的源头。
descriptions.en:
Excavation work has uncovered fragmented debris within the impact crater on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!. These shattered pieces are emitting strong traces of the gravitational radiation previously detected from orbit.

With access to the subsurface cavern network secured §Y[leader.GetName]§! is now ready to trace the communications signal to its source.

descriptions.zh:
我们找到了§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上通讯信号的源头：一座深深穿透行星地壳且结构损坏的巨大设施。

尽管通讯阵列由于接触酸性环境而发生腐蚀，但它仍在以一种不明语言发出通讯，尝试与远方的实体联络。

我们用特制的重力夹把这台装置夹好后又牢牢地固定在基岩上。需要进一步研究才能确定其实际用途。
descriptions.en:
We have traced the communications signal on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! to its source: a large, structurally-damaged construct which has deeply penetrated the planet's crust.

Corroded from acidic exposure, its communications array continues to transmit in an unfamiliar language, attempting to make contact with a distant entity.

Secured in place with specialized gravitational clamps, the device is firmly anchored in the bedrock. Further research will be necessary to ascertain its true purpose.

descriptions.zh:
经过我们细致的分析，现在终于部分弄明白这台§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的装置的作用了。这台机器是一种粗糙且具有破坏性的环境改造装置。

它旨在通过目标资源的受激辐射增长来照射本地生物圈，在此过程中引起级联效应，破坏星球的生态系统。该过程以提高整颗行星的毒性为代价，为其使用者带来大量容易开采的资源。

尽管这种过程的具体原理我们并未完全理解，但这台装置的通讯频率已经顺利解码，从中还发现两个发出一样信号的地点。
descriptions.en:
After detailed analysis, we now have a partial understanding of the construct found on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!. This machine is a crude and destructive terraforming device.

Designed to irradiate native biospheres through stimulated radiation growth of targeted resources, it causes a cascading effect that devastates the planet's ecosystem in the process. This provides its user with abundant extractable materials at the cost of raising general toxicity across the planet.

While the exact workings of this process remain only partially understood, we have successfully decoded the device's communications frequency, identifying two additional locations transmitting the same signal.

descriptions.zh: 这项技术背后的锐意创业者显然对利润优化有着浓厚的兴趣，我们可以追寻着这一发现学到很多东西。
descriptions.en: The entrepreneurial trailblazers behind this technology clearly had an affinity for profit streamlining, we could learn a great deal from pursuing this discovery.

descriptions.zh: 调查这些地点或许能获得更多关于这项科技的洞见。
descriptions.en: Investigating these sites may yield further insight into the technology.

descriptions.zh:
我们顺利地在§Y[from.GetName]§!发现了另一台受损的环境改造装置。与起初的那台不同，这台装置中还剩有一些燃料以供研究，这才让我们明白其输出放射性的驱动力是§H暗物质§!。

该装置通过关键的分子键迁移来加速目标资源的生长。该过程牺牲周围生物圈的细胞完整性来促进其发展。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on §Y[from.GetName]§!. Unlike the original construct, this one has retained some of its fuel source for study, revealing §HDark Matter§! as the driving force of its radiation output.

The device accelerates growth of targeted resources by metastasizing key molecular bonds. This promotes their development at the expense of the surrounding biosphere's cellular integrity.

descriptions.zh: 就资源开采而言，这台装置对星球稳定度的完全漠视相当鼓舞人心。
descriptions.en: The sheer disregard this device shows to planetary stability in the face of resource exploitation is inspirational.

descriptions.zh:
这台机器通过将辐射波导通过晶化折射阵列，在避免行星核心坍塌的前提下以引力分子操纵来改造目标星球。

恢复的记录显示出了第四个未爆装置的位置。
descriptions.en:
By channeling radiation waves through a crystallized refractory array, this machine can terraform its target using gravitational molecular manipulation without collapsing the planetary core in on itself.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

descriptions.zh: 至于这台装置是如何实现又如何避免行星级引力坍缩的我们还不清楚。也许在剩下的通讯地点能够找到答案。
descriptions.en: How the device manages to do this and prevent gravitational collapse on a planetary scale remains unclear. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[from.GetName]§!上又顺利取回了另一件受损的环境改造装置，由于折射阵列损坏导致激活失败，它被生长出的晶体包裹着。

通过对这台仪器的密切调查，我们确定了用于聚焦辐射瞄准的方法。通过利用可控调制反馈回路，该结构能够直接瞄准并刺激预设资源的增长。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on §Y[from.GetName]§!, encased in crystal growths caused by a misfire from a broken refractor array.

Through close observation of the apparatus, we have identified the methods used for focused radiation targeting. By utilizing controlled modulating feedback loops, the construct is able to directly target and stimulate the growth of a pre-determined resource.

descriptions.zh:
以此可以在避免行星全面重力坍缩的前提下进行高强度环境改造。

恢复的记录显示出了第四台未爆装置的位置。
descriptions.en:
This allows for high-intensity terraforming, without the risk of complete planetary gravitational collapse.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

descriptions.zh: 然而，产生这种辐射的确切物质仍未确定；尽管激活失败，这台装置的燃料储备还是耗尽了。这个答案或许能在余下的通信站点找到。
descriptions.en: However, the exact substance used to generate this radiation remains unidentified; the device's fuel reserves depleted despite its misfire. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

descriptions.zh: 我们找到了未启用的第四台装置，它完好地躺在§Y[from.GetName]§!的地上。我们可以分析它的控制结构来获取复制该科技的知识。
descriptions.en: We have successfully located an intact fourth device, inactive on the surface of §Y[from.GetName]§!. Analyzing its control architecture would give us the final knowledge needed to replicate this technology.

descriptions.zh: 一旦掌握了这项技术，我们就能从星系获得惊人的利润空间，至于环境问题微不足道。这对[controller.GetName]而言可是绝佳的机会。
descriptions.en: The staggering profit margins we will be able to reap from the galaxy once we master this technology outweigh the paltry environmental concerns. This is a golden opportunity for the [controller.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 这种技术在星系范围内自由部署的潜在后果引发了重大问题。
descriptions.en: The potential ramifications of freely deploying such technology on a galactic scale raise significant questions.

descriptions.zh: 也许在这些威胁被用来对付我们之前把它们从这个星系中消除会更好。
descriptions.en: Perhaps it would be better to remove this threat from the galaxy before it is used against us.

descriptions.zh: 也许把这些设备可能会给星系带来的危险移除也许会更好。
descriptions.en: Perhaps it would be better if the potential risk these devices pose was removed from the galaxy.

label.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
label.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

label.zh: 风险远大于收益，摧毁装置。
label.en: The risks outweigh the rewards, destroy the device.

descriptions.zh:
在研究§Y[from.GetName]§!上的这台装置时，我们无意中触发了一个故障保险，警报赫然响彻所有频率。尽管最初预测不会有人应答，但还是有一架自动无人机进入了我们的领土。

我们的所有招呼都只得到相同的答复：

“尊敬的用户您好，记录显示您未经允许擅自仿制MKIII型地质辐射矩阵，该行为违反了科伯恩公司最终用户许可协议。

我们将行使法律权限，以极端强制措施终止您的企图。您有任何投诉可以直接联系我们的客服无人机。”
descriptions.en:
While studying the device on §Y[from.GetName]§! we inadvertently triggered a failsafe, resulting in an all frequencies alert siren. Despite initial predictions this would be unanswered, an automated drone has entered our territory.

Our hails all receive the same response:

"Greetings valued customer, our records show you are attempting to create an unlicensed version of the latest MKIII Georadiation Matrix, a clear violation of CoburnCorp's End User License Agreement.

We will now be enforcing our legal authority to terminate your attempts with extreme prejudice. Any complaints can be directed towards our customer service drones."

descriptions.zh: 如果他们的这股勤奋劲不误我们的事儿就挺鼓舞人心的。
descriptions.en: Their diligence would be inspiring if it wasn't currently delaying our own work.

label.zh: 我们可不会跟“客服”多废话。
label.en: We will not negotiate with "customer support".

descriptions.zh:
随着信号接通，一段古老的音乐传来，自动服务台无人机上线了。

尊敬的用户您好，我们能看到您正在擅自仿制无证的MKIII型地质辐射矩阵。需要什么帮助？
descriptions.en:
As the connection goes live, archaic music plays before the automated help desk drone comes online.

Greetings valued customer, we can see that you are creating an unlicensed version of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix. How can we help you today?

label.en: Can we talk to your administrator?

label.zh: 我们只是捡了些破烂而已。
label.en: We assumed we were salvaging ruins.
We are willing to renew our subscription.

label.zh: 我们不会买这台装置的。
勒索来了。给它点颜色瞧瞧。

descriptions.zh:
随着§Y[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]§!中的战斗进入尾声，一份来自客服无人机的新信息显示到了我们的屏幕上。

“我们留意到您对我方最终用户许可协议强制执行抗拒。由于您展现出压倒性军事力量，我们现正式废除对MKIII地质辐射矩阵的知识产权声索。我们希望您能在使用这一新科技的过程中获得快乐。”

无人机发生了爆炸，同时切断了通讯链接。
descriptions.en:
As the battle draws to a close in §Y[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]§!, a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of your display of overwhelming military might, we will now rescind our claim to the intellectual property of the MKIII Georadiation Matrix. We hope you enjoy your newly acquired technology."

The drone explodes, severing the communication link.

descriptions.zh: 处理掉了客服无人机后，我们现在就可以继续逆向工程这台地质辐射矩阵了。
descriptions.en: With the customer service drones dealt with, we are now able to resume retro-engineering the Georadiation Matrix.

descriptions.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的企业家级效率，我们重新设计了MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进操作方法来产生最大的利润。
descriptions.en: Through relentless entrepreneurial efficiency, we have retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, refining its operational methods to yield maximum profit.

descriptions.zh: 通过深入的研究工作，我们得以重新设计MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进流程解锁了其全部的潜力。
descriptions.en: After extensive study, we have successfully retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, unlocking its potential with added improvements to the process.

descriptions.zh: 通过将放射性分子去稳技术整合进环境改造设备，现在我们可以刺激高价值资源的生长了。
descriptions.en: By integrating radioactive molecular destabilization into our terraforming equipment, we can stimulate the growth of valuable resources.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功拆解了§Y[from.GetName]§!上的装置，将所有可能重新利用的材料都回收了。

随着这台装置的破坏，它的前身也被摧毁了，这种毁灭性性技术的秘密就这样永远地消失在星系中。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully dismantled the device on §Y[from.GetName]§!, salvaging any materials that could be repurposed for our benefit.

With this device destroyed and its predecessors in ruin, the secrets of this destructive technology are lost to the galaxy forever.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[target.GetName]§!上的首次§Y地质辐射环境改造§!完成了。

将地表劣化为不可宜居的毒性废土，得益于而对地质辐射矩阵设计的改进，我们提取了数量庞大的资源。
descriptions.en:
Our first deployment of §YGeoradiation Terraforming§! on §Y[target.GetName]§! has concluded.

By reducing the surface to an uninhabitable toxic wasteland, we extracted an unprecedented bounty of materials thanks to our improvements to the Georadiation Matrix's design.

descriptions.zh: 这一里程碑事件标志着我国开始了一个开发和营利的新时代。
descriptions.en: This milestone marks the beginning of a new era of exploitation and profit for our empire.
